text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course... it was... Galloping through 
the mountains 
on the back of a bear... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehehe! 
Haaah... My heart is still pounding... 
If only it weren't a dream, but something 
real...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After having such a thrilling dream, 
Daring Tact was wide awake 
and couldn't get back to sleep at all...
